title: Cooling demand
brief: Program the cooling fan so it can be started manually or automatically when cooling is needed.
requirements: Manual Demand (I0.0) is ON when the operator requests cooling. Temperature OK (I0.1) is ON when the temperature is normal and OFF when it is too high.
Turn Cooling Fan (Q0.0) ON whenever Manual Demand (I0.0) is ON, regardless of the temperature.
Cooling Fan (Q0.0) must also be ON whenever Temperature OK (I0.1) is OFF, even when Manual Demand is OFF.
The fan must be OFF only when Manual Demand is OFF AND Temperature OK is ON. Respond to either input changing without any delay or memory.
hints: A normally closed (negated) contact passes logic when its operand is 0.
Use two parallel paths: one tests manual demand; the other tests NOT Temperature OK.
